_about: Hand-maintained data for docs/salary-cap.html (built by tools/build_cap.py). Primary source: Spotrac 2026-27 Nuggets cap table + multi-year page; cross-checked against Basketball-Reference contracts (DEN), Hoops Rumors and NBA.com. Never guess: use null for anything unverified (renders as an em dash with a note). Amounts are whole dollars. option: PO = player option, TO = team option, ETO = early termination option, NG = non-guaranteed. When a signing/waiver/option/extension happens, edit this file and rerun the builder.

thresholds.source: NBA.com official release, June 30, 2026; matches RealGM salary-cap history and The CBA Guide

tax_bill_estimates.source: Yossi Gozlan / CapSheets via Hoops Rumors (Sept 2026), which says Denver pays the repeater rate

cap_holds.items: Vlatko Cancar (Bird), DeMarcus Cousins, Troy Daniels, Justin Holiday, Richard Jefferson, David Roddy (two-way) and Markus Howard (two-way)
cap_holds.note: Spotrac lists these free-agent holds on Denver's books. Cap holds count only when a team is trying to open cap room; they never count toward the tax or the aprons. Denver is far over the cap, so they don't change anything this season.

exceptions.status: Unused, but unavailable while Denver is above the second apron

exceptions.type: Traded player exception (Peyton Watson sign-and-trade with Cleveland)

exceptions.type: Traded player exception (Hunter Tyson trade with Brooklyn)
exceptions.status: Expires Feb 5, 2027 (Spotrac). Hoops Rumors confirms Denver has two frozen TPEs but does not list this amount

picks: 2027 1st: owed to Oklahoma City unless it lands 1–5. If protected, Spotrac shows it rolling to 2028, then 2029, then 2030 with the same protection (Spotrac).
2031 1st: Denver owns its own pick plus Cleveland's unprotected 1st from the Peyton Watson sign-and-trade (Spotrac; Hoops Rumors).
2032 1st: owned by Brooklyn from the Cameron Johnson trade (Spotrac; Denver Sports calls it unprotected).

2nd-rounders: Denver received Minnesota's 2028 and Sacramento's 2031 2nds in the Brazile draft-night trade and Sacramento's 2032 2nd in the Watson deal (Hoops Rumors). Spotrac's pick grid has the full list of conditions.

key_dates.text: Last day to waive players on fully non-guaranteed deals (here, the three Exhibit 10s) without any 2026–27 cap charge. They must clear waivers before the season starts.

Roster limit drops from 21 to 18 (15 standard + 3 two-way) at 3:00 PM MT. Rookie-scale extension deadline at 4:00 PM MT (Strawther). Last day to convert an Exhibit 10 deal to two-way (Denver's 3 two-way slots are full).
2026–27 regular season begins. Two-way contracts become 50% guaranteed.
Deadline to exercise 2027–28 rookie-scale team options (Holmes, $5,547,138). It usually falls on Oct 31 but moves because of the weekend (Hoops Rumors).
Last day to waive a non-guaranteed player before contracts become guaranteed for the season on Jan 10. Denver has no non-guaranteed standard contracts right now.
Player option decisions for Jokić (2027–28) and Nnaji (2027–28), per Spotrac.

footnotes.jokic: Jokić 2027–28: Spotrac's multi-year table and Basketball-Reference both list $62,841,702. Spotrac's deadlines table lists $62,832,000 for the same option.
footnotes.gordon: Gordon: Spotrac cap hits are shown. Basketball-Reference adds his unlikely incentives each season ($33,658,037 / $36,350,680 / $39,043,323). Basketball-Reference's notes also call 2027–28 a player option, but its own table, Spotrac and Spotrac's contract page put the option on 2028–29.
footnotes.johnson: Johnson: Spotrac lists $22,500,000 guaranteed (base salary). Basketball-Reference lists $23,062,500, which includes the likely incentives.
footnotes.holmes: Holmes option date: Spotrac shows Oct 31. Hoops Rumors reports the league deadline moved to Mon Nov 2 because Oct 31 is a Saturday.
footnotes.brazile: Brazile: Basketball-Reference shows only 2026–27 and calls it a one-year minimum deal. Hoops Rumors (via HoopsHype's Michael Scotto) and Spotrac both report the four-year, $9,264,648 deal shown here.
footnotes.diallo: Diallo is missing from Basketball-Reference's Nuggets contract table. His one-year guaranteed rookie-minimum deal is confirmed by Spotrac, Hoops Rumors, ESPN (Shams Charania) and the NBA.com transaction log, so he is counted.
